devi_anga: Traditional associations vary; not an archaeological identification
mythology: The Ashtadasha tradition names Shrinkhala at Pradyumna. Pandua is one traditional identification. The exact original shrine and sacred image are unresolved.
pilgrimage_significance: A traditional Peetha association distinct from the documented surviving monument identities.
historical_notes: ASI protects the Pandua Minar and Bari Masjid separately. The scene represents those surviving monuments, not proof of an intact Shrinkhala temple.
